reason: Working existing GPU environment uses Python 3.10; modern Chemprop requires Python >=3.11. Version difference explicitly recorded.
split: Explicit separate train/validation/test paths from CLASS-001; no row random split
criterion: MSE optimization; checkpoint by validation MAE; test not used for model selection
notes: No Sobolev loss; not FASTSOLV exact reproduction or DMPNN-MoE; graph-only includes measured temperature/inverseT. Hybrid additionally receives all RDKit 2D descriptors. All custom features scaled on train by Chemprop. All raw targets and density are excluded from molecular input features.
